name: LlamaCloud
summary: Connects to managed indexes on LlamaCloud to provide queryable tools for use with MCP clients.

name: Liteparse
summary: Use this skill whenever a task involves a document file (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or image) and you need to read it or pull text, tables, or specific values out of it — to answer a question about its contents, look up a figure, or extract data. Provides fast, local, model-free extraction via the `lit` CLI with disciplined, low-cost search patterns.

name: Llamaparse
summary: Use this skill when the user asks to parse the content of an unstructured file (PDF, PPTX, DOCX...)
